draft.subject: Picking up where we left off, Ana
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

I know a kickoff slipped off the calendar last week, so I don't want to add noise. I also saw one invite has gone out to a teammate, which is a good start.

When you have a moment, the simplest next step is creating one real project with your actual tasks — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. There's also an in-app onboarding flow that walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to set up that first project with you on a short call this week — just name a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
